contentPattern.structure: row of bordered cards, each a centered award logo image + bold externally-linked title + short description sentence

suitableFor: award / recognition / accolade card rows (logo + title + short blurb)
partner or certification badge grids with an external link per item
bordered card grids with a centered logo and a body sentence
notSuitableFor: full-bleed photo teaser cards with a category tag (use cards-topic)
KPI statistic cards with a large figure + label (use cards-stats)
filterable article grids with a topic select + Load more (use cards-articles)
